settings.title: Settings
settings.createFilterHint: Automatically apply actions like starring, trashing, or tagging to new incoming mail.
settings.profileHint: Update how your name appears in the app menu.
settings.appearanceHint: Choose the interface theme and display language. Changes apply immediately.
settings.securityHint: Change the password for this single admin account.
settings.mailHint: Create and enable aliases, and choose the default send-from address.
settings.retentionHint: Messages older than the retention window are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
settings.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 90
settings.sendProvidersHint: Choose which free-tier service sends mail. Keys stored here are encrypted in the database; leave a field blank to keep the current value. Emptying via Clear falls back to the Worker secret.
settings.sendProvidersLoadFailed: Failed to load outbound provider settings
settings.sendFollowEnvHint: Uses SEND_PROVIDER when set, otherwise Resend.
settings.sendKeyPlaceholder: Paste API key to store encrypted
settings.sendKeyHintStored: Stored key ending in …{{hint}} — paste a new key to replace
settings.sendKeyWillClear: Will clear stored key on save
settings.sendKeyStatusMissing: Not configured — set here or via {{envVar}}
settings.defaultAliasHint: Used when composing a new message.
settings.noEnabledAlias: No enabled aliases yet. Create one first.
settings.displayNameMax: Display name must be at most 80 characters
settings.tagsHint: Organize mail with up to 50 tags. Use them in filters and the sidebar.
settings.tagDeleteConfirm: Delete this tag from all messages?
settings.tagsLoadFailed: Failed to load tags or filters
settings.filtersHint: Rules run on new inbound mail only, by priority (lower first). All matches stack.
settings.filterInvalid: Name and condition value are required

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Free-tier allowances consumed so far.
usage.errorHint: The provider API did not respond. Try refreshing in a moment.
usage.sendHint: Each recipient counts separately against these quotas.
usage.sendNotConfigured: Set {{envVar}} (or store the key in Settings → Mail) to send mail and track its quota.
usage.sendReportedAt: {{provider}} last reported its own tally on the send at {{value}}; anything sent since is counted by this app. Whichever figure is higher is shown.
usage.sendNoReportYet: {{provider}} only reports its tally while accepting a send, and has not done so yet. Until then these numbers are counted by this app alone.
usage.cloudflareNotConfigured: Set both CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (Account Analytics → Read) to read Cloudflare usage.
usage.cloudflareErrorUnauthorized: Cloudflare rejected the credentials. Check that CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID matches the account and that the token grants Account Analytics → Read.
usage.cloudflareErrorQueryFailed: Cloudflare accepted the credentials but returned an error for the usage query. Try refreshing in a moment.
usage.cloudflareErrorUnreachable: Could not reach the Cloudflare API. Try refreshing in a moment.
usage.freeTierNote: Paid plans allow more; these are free-tier figures only.

apiKeys.title: Project keys
apiKeys.hint: Let other sites send transactional mail through this domain. Prefer Disable over Delete so send history stays available.
apiKeys.resendRequired: Outbound mail needs an active provider API key (Settings → Mail, or a Worker secret).
apiKeys.providerRequired: Outbound mail needs an active provider API key (Settings → Mail, or a Worker secret).
apiKeys.createHint: The plaintext secret is shown only once after creation. Store it in your site’s server environment.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.aliasHint: Multiple keys may share the same alias (e.g. noreply@).
apiKeys.softQuotaHint: Soft limits — concurrent requests may overshoot slightly.
apiKeys.needAlias: Create an enabled alias before adding an API key.
apiKeys.createInvalid: Name, alias, and integer limits are required.
apiKeys.secretHint: This secret is shown only once. It cannot be recovered later — create a new key if you lose it.
apiKeys.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? This also permanently removes its send logs. Prefer Disable if you only want to stop sending.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.routingHint: New aliases can receive mail when Cloudflare’s catch-all rule routes to this Worker. If you route each address separately, add a rule for each alias. Sending requires a configured provider and a verified sending domain.
aliases.domainMissing: Set EMAIL_DOMAIN on this Worker before adding an alias.
aliases.empty: No aliases yet. Create one to start receiving mail.

integrations.title: Project integrations
integrations.intro: Let your other projects send through this site over HTTP. Each project key is bound to one sender address.
integrations.serverOnly: Configure environment variables on your project server. Keep email keys out of browser code, public repositories and frontend environment variables.
integrations.retryHint: Use a unique idempotency key per business email and reuse it for retries within 24 hours. If acceptance is unknown, check the provider before resending with another key.
integrations.logsHint: Metadata is retained for 30 days without message bodies. “Provider accepted” does not mean delivered. Requests rejected by authentication, validation or quota checks are not logged here.
integrations.noLogs: No send logs yet. Send a request from your project to see it here.
integrations.logsFailed: Unable to load send logs. Try again.
integrations.testHint: Uses your project Bearer key to send one real email to the recipient you enter. Counts toward key and provider usage. This checks the HTTP path; your real project still needs its own integration test.
integrations.testKey: Project API key (used only for this test)
integrations.testAccepted: Provider accepted. Check the recipient inbox.
integrations.unknownHint: Acceptance is unknown. Check provider records and the recipient inbox before sending again.
integrations.addressUncertain: Creation response was lost. Reloading addresses; check existing addresses before retrying.
integrations.capFailed: Unable to read integration capabilities. Refresh to retry.
integrations.domainUnverified: Sender domain is unverified. Check the provider and test sending.
integrations.routingHint: Inbound routing is unverified. Cloudflare catch-all routing lets new addresses receive mail; individual routing rules require a new Cloudflare rule for each address. An address is not a separate login account.
integrations.createInFlow: You can create an address during setup, even if none is available.
integrations.addressCreated: {{address}} was created and will be kept if key creation fails. Continue when ready.
integrations.localPartHint: Enter only the part before @, using letters, digits and . _ + -. Do not enter a full email address.
integrations.keyUncertain: Key creation could not be confirmed. Repeated submission is blocked. Close this dialog and check the list. If a key was created without its secret, disable it before creating another.
integrations.deleteWarning: Deleting also removes this key’s send logs, usage and idempotency records. Disable it first to retain history.
integrations.quotaHint: Key soft limits count accepted requests and may be exceeded slightly under concurrency. Provider shared usage counts recipients. Neither is a hard spending cap. View provider totals on the Usage page.
integrations.rotationHint: To rotate: create a new key, update and verify your project, then disable the old key. Secrets cannot be recovered after closing their dialog.
integrations.smtpHint: SMTP remains disabled as requested. A Cloudflare Worker cannot listen on public SMTP ports. Native SMTP requires a separate plan and activation decision; credentials, revocation and quotas are managed by Cloudflare. Site HTTP keys cannot authenticate SMTP.
integrations.disableAddressHint: Disabling {{address}} blocks new inbound mail and new send authorizations for all {{count}} bound project keys. In-flight requests cannot be recalled. Keys and history are retained.
